errors.unsupported: Your browser does not support live camera capture. Open TricityMatch on a phone or use a device with a camera.
errors.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow camera permission in your browser, then try again.
errors.noCamera: No camera found on this device. Open TricityMatch on a phone to verify.
errors.timedOut: We never got access to your camera. Look for the camera permission prompt in your browser and choose Allow, then try again, or open TricityMatch on your phone.
errors.startFailed: Could not start the camera. Make sure no other app is using it, then try again.
errors.stillStarting: The camera is still starting. Wait a moment until you can see yourself, then capture.

hint: Center your face in the circle, good light, look at the camera.
startHint: We capture your selfie live. No uploads, so nobody can fake it.
